# Script capabilities

Roblox's sandboxed-container system gates APIs behind named capabilities. A
script inside a container with `Sandboxed` set only reaches APIs whose
capability the container grants. Outside a sandboxed container these tags do
not restrict anything - but they are the best available map of which subsystem
each API belongs to, which is useful when deciding what a module should own.
